description.value:
The Yondaime's Flying Thunder God technique. You instantly teleport from your current square to any square containing a Hiraishin marker you have previously placed (a special seal-tag you can throw, embed in a kunai, or imprint on a willing ally).

Placing a marker is a 1-action activity (Interact with the kunai/scroll containing the seal). Markers persist indefinitely until you Dismiss them or someone Detects Magic and counters at counteract rank 9+.

When you cast Hiraishin, choose one marker within 1 mile. You appear in an adjacent unoccupied square. You may bring up to (your spellcasting modifier) willing creatures adjacent to you along for the jump.

You may cast Hiraishin as a free action (instead of 1 action) if the triggering moment is a reaction window such as an opponent's Strike against you.

This jutsu is the foundation of Minato's reputation as the Yellow Flash. It is uniquely complex chakra-physics; the seal-imprinting requirement is non-negotiable.

system.requirements: an active Hiraishin marker within range

target.value: self plus up to spellcasting mod allies
